headline: Tullow Oil Agrees to $112 Million Upfront Tax Settlement with Ghana
summary: Tullow Oil reached an agreement with the Ghanaian government to resolve outstanding tax disputes stemming from two international arbitration cases by paying $112 million upfront, pending parliamentary approval.
why: Tullow Oil is an independent oil producer operating major offshore crude fields in West Africa.

impacts.name: Tullow Oil
impacts.why: Tullow Oil agreed to pay $112 million upfront to resolve long-standing tax disputes in Ghana.
